svg.title: Three-Stage Small-Diameter Well - Bathing Supply
svg.desc: Key: 温泉供水 = bathing-water supply; 地热回水 = geothermal return; 自来水 = mains water; 回灌水 = reinjection; 回水 = return; 深井泵 = deep-well pump; 地热分割器 = geothermal flow separator. Source dimensions >171 mm, 151 mm and interval >500 m. Well design, separation, pressure and water quality are project-specific.
